description: Entity Framework Core migration class defining initial database schema for eShopOnWeb project, including tables for baskets, catalog, orders, order items, and associated constraints and sequences.

classes.name: InitialModel
classes.description: Migration class that sets up initial database schema for the eShopWeb application.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to create database sequences, tables, constraints, and indexes during migration.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to remove the database objects created in Up, when rolling back the migration.
